add.title: Trăind de gardă/ Deținut transgender – dublu condamnat în închisoare de către „oamenii cu epoleți”
add.summary: Moldovan investigative outlet Ziarul de Gardă (15 June 2024) documents the four-year detention of Igor Brumarețchi, a transgender man (registered female at birth in 1972, documents changed to male in 2007), who served his sentence in Moldova's penitentiary system, mostly at Penitentiary No. 6 in Soroca. He says he was held alone in unsanitary, rat-infested cells — including for long periods in the disciplinary isolation unit ('izolator disciplinar') — supposedly for his own safety, while his request for sector 12 (the unit for detainees requiring protection) was refused. He describes staff humiliation: forced strip body searches, 'go to the gynaecologist' calls over the intercom, opening his bathroom door, and calling him 'Natașa' at roll-call, and says only self-harm and hunger strikes got him heard. The National Penitentiary Administration (ANP) replied that he was detained alone 'at his own written request' and without any rights being violated, and that the discrimination claims were unconfirmed; Brumarețchi says he will sue in Moldovan courts and the ECtHR, and ZdG has notified the Ombudsman and GENDERDOC-M. Outcome: de facto placement of a trans detainee by birth sex in the men's system with prolonged solitary-style isolation, refused protection-ward placement, and no special-unit option.

add.title: Deținuți ai prejudecăților în instituțiile de stat. Persoane LGBT+, la un pas de suicid. Povestea tragică a unui locuitor al satului Dubna
add.summary: Observatorul de Nord (7 April 2025) corroborates the same case: Igor Brumarețchi from Dubna village (Soroca district) spent three years locked alone in a cell at Penitentiary No. 6 in Soroca, fully isolated from other detainees and humiliated by prison staff on grounds of sexual orientation, which brought him to the edge of suicide. The piece states the authorities admit homophobia still persists in state institutions and say they are training staff and preparing stricter penalties for discrimination and harassment; the full investigation appeared on anticoruptie.md. Confirms the solitary-style isolation placement practice for a trans detainee in Moldovan prison No. 6 as of 2025.
